info.name: Weather Forecast Service Postman Collection
info.description:
Current weather, hourly and daily forecasts, and ground elevation for
any point on Earth, addressed by latitude and longitude. Forecasts are
available from the default blended model and from the NOAA GFS model,
so the same location can be compared across models. Backed by the free
public Open-Meteo service, so the server URL is real and reachable and
a gateway generated from this specification can be called end to end.

OpenAPI version: 3.0.3

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Kong gateway.
